extensions.description: This agent's interface is MCP over stdio, not A2A. The card is a capability manifest and discovery record, not an A2A endpoint declaration; no A2A endpoint exists for this agent. The params carry the invocation facts a client config generator needs to wire this server from the card alone.

description: Qompass AI's generation broker: an MCP server (stdio transport, rmcp, MCP modern era 2026-07-28) that fronts image, video, and TTS generation routes behind one job queue and one per-job cost ledger. A pure lane-eligibility gate decides at submit time whether a job's lane may use its route (hosted routes whose terms bar adult content are SFW-only in the route table), and every job — allowed, denied, completed, failed, or cancelled — is recorded in an append-only metadata-only ledger. This card is a discovery record and capability manifest for catalogues, registries, and client-config generators; Cartone does not expose an A2A endpoint.
name: Cartone

skills.description: Submit a generation job to a route and track or cancel it: submit_job, get_job, list_jobs, cancel_job. The lane-eligibility gate runs at submit; a denied job is returned as a ledgered record with the gate's reason.
skills.name: Generation job queue

skills.description: Inspect the route table with list_routes: each route's kind, enablement, eligible lanes, unit cost, and whether an executor command is configured and the route is available.
skills.name: Route catalog

skills.description: Read cost accounting with ledger_summary: job counts by status and total cost, overall and per route and per lane, over the append-only metadata-only ledger.
skills.name: Per-job cost ledger
